title: Translation factor from the binary dot product
statement: Let $f\colon\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb R$ and let $z,\gamma\in\mathbb F_2^n$. The vector Fourier coefficient of $x\mapsto f(x+z)$ at $\gamma$ equals the original coefficient multiplied by the binary sign of the dot product of $\gamma$ and $z$.
